purpose: Evaluate ischemic-stroke D0 phenotype reproducibility between PCORnet and the frozen audited OMOP build without retuning the ETL or phenotype after observing disagreement.

source_reference.name: PSU PROMIS EHR-only D0
source_reference.diagnosis_rule: DX normalized by uppercasing, trimming, and removing decimal points must be in the explicit locked ischemic-stroke ICD-9-CM/ICD-10-CM code lists. DX_TYPE is not part of the primary exact-code matcher.
source_reference.overnight_rule: calendar-day difference between ADMIT_DATE and DISCHARGE_DATE is at least 1 day; this is not a >24-hour timestamp rule
source_reference.index_date_rule: for each qualifying encounter choose the first primary stroke diagnosis ordered by DX_DATE with nulls last then normalized DX; encounter index date is COALESCE(DX_DATE, ADMIT_DATE, DISCHARGE_DATE)
source_reference.patient_index_rule: select the first qualifying encounter per PATID ordered by index date then ENCOUNTERID
source_reference.age_rule: after first qualifying encounter selection, require floor(date_difference_days(BIRTH_DATE, INDEX_DATE) / 365.0) >= 18
source_reference.registry_rule: no registry gating or registry augmentation
source_reference.dx_type_sensitivity: recognized DX_TYPE restriction may be reported only as a sensitivity/diagnostic and must not define the primary D0 cohort

patient_linkage.rule: exact source-derived bridge after the same trimming/string normalization used by the frozen ETL

primary_transformation_fidelity.name: lineage-faithful D0
primary_transformation_fidelity.purpose: Test whether the frozen OMOP representation preserves the exact source-defined D0 phenotype.
primary_transformation_fidelity.omop_representation: Use native OMOP person/visit/condition rows for transformed events and dates, with frozen lineage only where the source phenotype requires a field not represented natively in OMOP core, especially PDX == P and the exact source diagnosis code identity.
primary_transformation_fidelity.lineage_policy: Lineage may classify source-only phenotype semantics but must not be used to alter the frozen ETL or phenotype definition.
primary_transformation_fidelity.expected_interpretation: Discordance is decomposed into source ineligibility, ETL exclusion, missing lineage/materialization, index-date representation, or other unexplained causes. No category is assumed to be an ETL defect until demonstrated.

secondary_native_portability.name: native-OMOP portable D0 sensitivity
secondary_native_portability.purpose: Quantify how a D0-like phenotype behaves when expressed using OMOP-native Standard concepts only.
secondary_native_portability.stroke_rule: Resolve the locked explicit ICD code list through the frozen vocabulary to active Standard Condition concepts using exact source concepts plus Maps to semantics; preserve one-to-many mappings.
secondary_native_portability.visit_rule: use OMOP visit concepts corresponding to the frozen EI/IP mappings (EI=262, IP=9201)
secondary_native_portability.overnight_rule: visit_end_date - visit_start_date is at least 1 calendar day
secondary_native_portability.age_rule: apply the same post-index floor(days/365.0) adult rule using OMOP person birth date
secondary_native_portability.primary_diagnosis_limitation: PDX has no native OMOP core equivalent in this frozen ETL. Therefore PDX == P is intentionally absent from this secondary portable phenotype and the resulting cohort is not treated as the primary transformation-fidelity estimand.

primary: exact index-date agreement among shared patients
secondary: native-OMOP portable cohort size and overlap

scope.deferred: D1 and D3 are not yet locked because their lipid LOINC whitelist must first be imported or otherwise versioned and hashed as a reproducible study artifact; imaging and lipid evidence windows will be locked before those outcome queries.
